comment_regular: Verified this helper takes EffectNode* and explicit TESObjectREFR* linkContext, while preserving incoming EBX and forwarding it as the second stack argument to each hit-effect vtable +0x80 callback. That callback's third argument is directly typed TESChildCELL* and updates parentCell. The hidden EBX value is the owner reference in the modified-extra load path; Player_LinkModifiedForm reaches this helper with EBX as a saved-reference-list cursor, so a universal owner-reference interpretation remains Candidate.
